name: Dala

lines.text: You have come a long way off the path.
It is a wall. It falls down. I put it back. That is the whole of it.
There is nothing in there. I have not been in there. My mother had not been in there.
You can write it down. Everybody writes it down. The stones do not mind.

notes:
**The trace, given a face.** Canon puts the Mask Family schism and the hidden sanctuary in these ranges, and none of that is on stage -- Sira, Meera and Thren are four hundred years of backstory and this map is one afternoon.

So the player meets somebody who keeps the wall and does not know why, in the third generation of not knowing why. Dala answers every question honestly and the answers do not add up to anything, which is the point: the ground remembers and the people have agreed not to. Nothing Dala says can be pushed past.
